variants.optimizerInput: Ocean Window, Wall Decor, Tier 3, Candy Core. ONE SINGLE window product only, photographed almost straight-on against a plain neutral wall. Use one simple thick rectangular cream frame with exactly four outer edges and ONE uninterrupted glass opening filling most of the object. Through the glass, show an unmistakable bright blue ocean: a large horizontal band of blue water, a crisp visible ocean horizon across the opening, and pale blue sky above it. The ocean view must occupy at least 70 percent of the interior opening and be the dominant visual cue even at thumbnail size. Add only tiny candy-pink and aqua trim on the physical frame. NO abstract panels, NO extra frames, NO geometric wall sculpture, NO second window, NO grid, NO collage, NO furniture, NO text.

Ocean Window, Wall Decor, Tier 3, Candy Core. Create ONE simple recessed wall window with a single continuous rectangular opening. Inside the opening: obvious blue sea below a straight horizon line and blue sky above, nothing else. One cream frame, restrained pink/aqua Candy Core edge trim, slight wall-contact depth and shadow. Centered product-only view. NO panels, NO separate panes, NO decorative geometry covering the ocean, NO multiple windows, NO room scene, NO text.

Art Gallery Wall, Wall Decor, Tier 3, Adventure Club. EXACTLY THREE large picture frames and NOTHING ELSE as the product. Mount all three directly on one very shallow narrow backing strip against a plain neutral wall. Frame 1 contains a bold mountain trail landscape, frame 2 contains a large compass-and-map travel graphic with no words, frame 3 contains a colorful ocean/coast adventure landscape. The three artworks must fill almost the entire image and remain obvious at thumbnail size. Use thick readable frame bevels and tiny brass mounting clips only. NO fourth frame, NO extra mini frames, NO ledge, NO shelf, NO floor, NO bags, NO bench, NO plants, NO furniture, NO room vignette, NO text.

Art Gallery Wall, Wall Decor, Tier 3, Adventure Club. Make one compact wall-hung TRIPTYCH: exactly three oversized framed artworks side by side, each visibly different and adventure themed—mountain path, compass/map shapes, coastal travel scene. Frames dominate at least 90 percent of the product silhouette. One thin hidden backboard and wall shadow only. Plain background. NO ledges, NO props, NO floor line, NO furniture, NO extra frames, NO empty panels, NO text.

Luxe Command Desk, Desks & Tech, Tier 5, Star Luxe. ONE FREESTANDING DESK ONLY on a seamless light-neutral studio background. Make the furniture silhouette unmistakable: one broad horizontal midnight-blue desktop, exactly two separate gold-edged pedestal supports touching the ground, one integrated drawer cabinet under the right side, and a thin low monitor shelf attached only to the desktop. Show open negative space beneath the center of the desk and all floor-contact edges. Add restrained gold star inlays and premium navy lacquer/metal/glass materials. NO room, NO walls, NO cabinetry behind it, NO side stations, NO cockpit, NO command-center architecture, NO floor platform, NO surrounding screens, NO duplicate desk, NO text.

Luxe Command Desk, Desks & Tech, Tier 5, Star Luxe. Product photography of exactly ONE luxury executive desk. Wide curved navy worktop, two clearly separated gold-trimmed pedestal legs, small built-in drawers, one very shallow attached monitor bridge, subtle star-shaped hardware. Entire desk fully visible with lots of blank studio space around it and a simple grounded shadow. It must look movable freestanding furniture, not a room installation. NO architecture, NO wall unit, NO cockpit, NO surrounding cabinets, NO multiple consoles, NO text.
